## ranui adapter rules

ranui-specific rules (31 MUST, 41 SHOULD, 5 MAY).

| ID                                                                  | Level  | Rule                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Proof                                                               |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [R-STYLE-1](../DESIGN.md#ranui-default-visual-direction)            | SHOULD | Use existing token roles to choose exact dimensions; do not introduce a second "premium" scale.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |                                                                     |
| [R-STYLE-2](../DESIGN.md#ranui-default-visual-direction)            | SHOULD | Treat glass and expressive demonstrations as explicit surface or theme choices, not as default text or control backgrounds.                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |                                                                     |
| [R-STYLE-3](../DESIGN.md#ranui-default-visual-direction)            | MUST   | Preserve reading contrast and the same interaction semantics across themes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | browser                                                             |
| [R-STYLE-4](../DESIGN.md#ranui-default-visual-direction)            | SHOULD | Apply the shared [style brief](../DESIGN.md#style-coherence-across-components-and-pages) before changing a family.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |                                                                     |
| [R-STYLE-5](../DESIGN.md#ranui-default-visual-direction)            | SHOULD | Review a family change in a realistic composed page with neighboring controls; a polished isolated component does not establish a coherent product.                                                                                                                                                                                                     |                                                                     |
| [R-USE-1](../DESIGN.md#how-to-use-this-file)                        | SHOULD | Prefer **semantic tokens** (`--ran-color-*`, `--ran-space-*`, …) over raw scales or hex.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                                                                     |
| [R-USE-2](../DESIGN.md#how-to-use-this-file)                        | SHOULD | Decide by **role/state**, not by eyeballing a value. The value is chosen for you.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |                                                                     |
| [R-USE-3](../DESIGN.md#how-to-use-this-file)                        | SHOULD | When a choice is unresolved, mark it explicitly instead of burying a guess in code.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |                                                                     |
| [R-USE-4](../DESIGN.md#how-to-use-this-file)                        | SHOULD | Design **all reachable states** (default, hover, active, focus, disabled, loading, empty, error), not just the happy path.                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                     |
| [R-USE-5](../DESIGN.md#how-to-use-this-file)                        | MUST   | **Verify the rendered result** in the themes and widths the change affects; code review alone is not enough.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | browser                                                             |
| [R-USE-6](../DESIGN.md#how-to-use-this-file)                        | SHOULD | Resolve conflicts in this order: **user goals → verified evidence → this file → repo guidance (`CLAUDE.md`) → shipped patterns → general heuristics.**                                                                                                                                                                                                  |                                                                     |
| [R-CHECK-1](../DESIGN.md#what-is-machine-checked)                   | MUST   | A change adds no new `verify:design` violations; the per-file baseline is a debt ratchet, not permission to add violations.                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | review                                                              |
| [R-CHECK-2](../DESIGN.md#what-is-machine-checked)                   | MUST   | A component that implements a drag drives it with Pointer Events (`pointerdown`/`pointermove`/`pointerup`/`pointercancel`), not a `mousemove`-only loop, so touch can drive it.                                                                                                                                                                         | check:mouse-only-drag                                               |
| [R-BUNDLE-1](../DESIGN.md#looking-at-the-whole-system-at-once)      | SHOULD | Use the bundle from the matching installed version; a reference bundle is not evidence that the host application passed acceptance.                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |                                                                     |
| [R-COLOR-1](../DESIGN.md#ranui-color--a-state-ladder-not-a-palette) | SHOULD | **Use the semantic layer in the table below, not the scale, in components.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |                                                                     |
| [R-COLOR-2](../DESIGN.md#ranui-color--a-state-ladder-not-a-palette) | SHOULD | Text and icons on a primary surface use `--ran-color-primary-text` (the inverse, which flips too).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |                                                                     |
| [R-COLOR-3](../DESIGN.md#ranui-color--a-state-ladder-not-a-palette) | SHOULD | Reserve **blue** for **links (`--ran-color-link`) and the focus ring** only; green means success, amber warning, red danger/error.                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |                                                                     |
| [R-COLOR-4](../DESIGN.md#ranui-color--a-state-ladder-not-a-palette) | SHOULD | Read the theme declarations rather than assuming every semantic value follows one scale step.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                     |
| [R-COLOR-5](../DESIGN.md#ranui-color--a-state-ladder-not-a-palette) | MUST   | Do not hard-code a hex/rgb in a component for a value that follows the theme.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | check:bare-colour                                                   |
| [R-COLOR-6](../DESIGN.md#ranui-color--a-state-ladder-not-a-palette) | MUST   | A component token's colour fallback starts with a **token that flips** (`var(--ran-gray-alpha-100, …)`, `var(--ran-blue-100, …)`, `var(--ran-color-text, …)`), never a bare light-only literal — otherwise it breaks in dark mode. A final literal behind that token, as in `var(--ran-btn-background, var(--ran-color-primary, #111113))`, is allowed. | check:dark-unsafe-fallback                                          |
| [R-SPACE-1](../DESIGN.md#ranui-spacing--a-limited-rhythmic-scale)   | MUST   | Pick spacing from the scale; do not invent `20px`/`28px` — a limited set is what creates the page's rhythm.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | check:spacing-scale                                                 |
| [R-SPACE-2](../DESIGN.md#ranui-spacing--a-limited-rhythmic-scale)   | MUST   | Intrinsic dimensions (`width`, `height`, their `min-`/`max-` forms, `font-size`, `line-height`, `border-radius`) take `--ran-size-*` or role tokens, never `--ran-space-*`, so consumers can retune either scale without perturbing the other.                                                                                                          | check:sizing-scale                                                  |
| [R-TYPE-1](../DESIGN.md#ranui-typography--choose-a-role-not-a-size) | SHOULD | Decide text style by **role**: ask "what role is this text?" (heading / label / copy / button) and the style follows. Do not pick raw px per instance.                                                                                                                                                                                                  |                                                                     |
| [R-TYPE-2](../DESIGN.md#ranui-typography--choose-a-role-not-a-size) | SHOULD | Reference the role tokens (`var(--ran-{component}-…, var(--ran-text-{role}…, fallback))`) instead of hand-copying the px/weight number.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                                                                     |
| [R-TYPE-3](../DESIGN.md#ranui-typography--choose-a-role-not-a-size) | SHOULD | Follow the Notes column of the role table; for example, compact action labels stay on one line while field labels may wrap.                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |                                                                     |
| [R-TYPE-4](../DESIGN.md#ranui-typography--choose-a-role-not-a-size) | MAY    | Transient/decorative UI that maps to no role (an active-link weight bump, a player gesture-flash overlay) keeps its own one-off component token instead of being forced into the nearest role — see `r-link`'s `--ran-link-active-font-weight` and `r-player`'s `--ran-player-gesture-flash-font-weight`.                                               |                                                                     |
| [R-RADIUS-1](../DESIGN.md#ranui-radius--elevation)                  | SHOULD | Controls (button, input, select) → `sm`. Cards / dialogs → `md`. Large surfaces → `lg`. Pills / avatars → `full`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |                                                                     |
| [R-ELEV-1](../DESIGN.md#ranui-radius--elevation)                    | SHOULD | Pick the shadow tier from the table below by _what the element is_.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |                                                                     |
| [R-ELEV-2](../DESIGN.md#ranui-radius--elevation)                    | SHOULD | Make sure each tier is actually perceptible — a shadow you can't see fails its job.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |                                                                     |
| [R-ELEV-3](../DESIGN.md#ranui-radius--elevation)                    | MUST   | A floating overlay does not fall back to `--ran-shadow-elevated` (the card tier) — it would look flat.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | test:packages/ranui/test/unit/theme.semantic-tokens.test.ts, review |
| [R-ELEV-4](../DESIGN.md#ranui-radius--elevation)                    | MUST   | An overlay's shadow clearly lifts it off the page.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | browser                                                             |
| [R-Z-1](../DESIGN.md#ranui-radius--elevation)                       | MUST   | The z-index sits on the element that is **positioned and portaled** (the host); a z-index on an inner shadow node is trapped in the host's stacking context and does nothing against page content.                                                                                                                                                      | test:packages/ranui/test/e2e/dropdown-layer.spec.ts                 |
| [R-Z-2](../DESIGN.md#ranui-radius--elevation)                       | MUST   | Overlays use the stacking tiers in the table below, so a select opened inside a modal stays visible.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | test:packages/ranui/test/e2e/dropdown-layer.spec.ts                 |
| [R-Z-3](../DESIGN.md#ranui-radius--elevation)                       | MUST   | Toasts and notifications sit on the top tier (`--ran-z-message`), above modals and dropdowns.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | review                                                              |
| [R-Z-4](../DESIGN.md#ranui-radius--elevation)                       | MUST   | Override a tier globally (set `--ran-z-dropdown` on `:root`) or per component (`--ran-dropdown-host-z-index`, `--ran-modal-root-z-index`, `--ran-message-z-index`), never with `!important`.                                                                                                                                                            | test:packages/ranui/test/e2e/dropdown-layer.spec.ts, review         |
| [R-Z-5](../DESIGN.md#ranui-radius--elevation)                       | MUST   | An overlay open while the page scrolls re-runs its placement on `scroll`/`resize` so it tracks its trigger (e.g. inside a sticky header).                                                                                                                                                                                                               | test:packages/ranui/test/unit/utils.floating.test.ts                |
| [R-Z-6](../DESIGN.md#ranui-radius--elevation)                       | MUST   | Raise an enclosing wrapper only while that overlay actually paints, including its closing transition.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | browser                                                             |
| [R-Z-7](../DESIGN.md#ranui-radius--elevation)                       | SHOULD | Verify reflected open/closing attributes against the component API before using selectors.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                     |
| [R-MOTION-1](../DESIGN.md#ranui-radius--elevation)                  | MUST   | Do not animate a theme switch.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | browser                                                             |
| [R-MOTION-2](../DESIGN.md#ranui-radius--elevation)                  | MUST   | **Palette props get no default transition.** `background` / `background-color`, `color`, `border-color`, `box-shadow`, `fill`, `stroke` — none of them, on any element that carries a theme-driven color. Hover/focus feedback on these props snaps.                                                                                                    | review, browser                                                     |
| [R-MOTION-3](../DESIGN.md#ranui-radius--elevation)                  | MAY    | **Motion props may transition.** `transform`, `opacity`, and box-geometry props (`left` / `top` / `width` / `height` / `font-size`) do not follow the theme — checkbox pops, tab ink-bars, ripples all stay animated.                                                                                                                                   |                                                                     |
| [R-MOTION-4](../DESIGN.md#ranui-radius--elevation)                  | MUST   | Do not use `transition: all` or bare-duration shorthands (`transition: 0.2s` — which means `all`); they silently include palette props.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | review                                                              |
| [R-MOTION-5](../DESIGN.md#ranui-radius--elevation)                  | MUST   | Every removed default keeps its `--ran-*-transition` hook var, so a consumer who wants palette fades can opt in per component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | review                                                              |
| [R-COMP-1](../DESIGN.md#ranui-components--how-to-apply-the-system)  | SHOULD | Reuse existing semantic native controls or supported ranui primitives; do not rebuild them merely for styling.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |                                                                     |
| [R-COMP-2](../DESIGN.md#ranui-components--how-to-apply-the-system)  | SHOULD | Choose a ranui component when its contract fits.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |                                                                     |
| [R-COMP-3](../DESIGN.md#ranui-components--how-to-apply-the-system)  | MUST   | Preserve native form and keyboard semantics, including supported native controls in overlay slots ([INTERACTION §2](../INTERACTION.md#2-reachable-controls-and-predictable-focus)).                                                                                                                                                                     | browser                                                             |
| [R-COMP-4](../DESIGN.md#ranui-components--how-to-apply-the-system)  | SHOULD | Theme through **CSS variables**, **`::part()`**, or the **`sheet`** attribute (escape hatch). CSS variables cross Shadow DOM; selectors do not.                                                                                                                                                                                                         |                                                                     |
| [R-COMP-5](../DESIGN.md#ranui-components--how-to-apply-the-system)  | SHOULD | Component tokens default to semantic tokens: `var(--ran-btn-background, var(--ran-color-primary, #111113))`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |                                                                     |
| [R-COMP-6](../DESIGN.md#ranui-components--how-to-apply-the-system)  | SHOULD | Map states to the color ladder: default → `bg`/`text`; hover → `bg-hover` / `border-hover` / `primary-hover`; active → `bg-active` / `primary-active`; disabled → appropriate disabled tokens, with opacity only when needed and still legible; focus → focus ring.                                                                                     |                                                                     |
| [R-COMP-7](../DESIGN.md#ranui-components--how-to-apply-the-system)  | MUST   | **Interactive cards opt in**: `r-card` only reacts to hover with the `hoverable` attribute (border 400 → 500 + elevated shadow). Non-interactive cards stay inert — no hover feedback on something that isn't clickable.                                                                                                                                | browser                                                             |
| [R-COMP-8](../DESIGN.md#ranui-components--how-to-apply-the-system)  | SHOULD | **When the host needs ranui theme switching UI**, use `<r-theme-switch>` (system / light / dark segmented pill, wired to `setTheme`/localStorage, syncs across instances and updates `theme-color` metas) instead of hand-rolling equivalent toggles.                                                                                                   |                                                                     |
| [R-COMP-9](../DESIGN.md#ranui-components--how-to-apply-the-system)  | SHOULD | Preserve an existing host theme authority; R-COMP-8 does not require adding a theme switch.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |                                                                     |
| [R-COMP-10](../DESIGN.md#ranui-components--how-to-apply-the-system) | SHOULD | Localize `<r-theme-switch>` with `label` / `label-system` / `label-light` / `label-dark`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |                                                                     |
| [R-COMP-11](../DESIGN.md#ranui-components--how-to-apply-the-system) | MAY    | **Typography ships with the system**: `import 'ranui/fonts'` (or link `dist/fonts/fonts.css`) self-hosts Geist Sans + Geist Mono (variable, OFL-licensed) — the canonical faces behind `--ran-font-family` / `--ran-font-mono`. Without it the stacks fall back to system fonts.                                                                        |                                                                     |
| [R-TOKEN-1](../DESIGN.md#a-fallback-must-name-a-token-that-exists)  | MUST   | Declared tokens, including fallbacks, name tokens that exist in the installed theme; an undefined `var()` can silently discard the entire declaration.                                                                                                                                                                                                  | check:undefined-token-fallback                                      |
| [R-HOST-1](../DESIGN.md#hidden-must-keep-working)                   | MUST   | An author `:host` display rule preserves `:host([hidden]) { display: none; }`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | check:hidden-inert                                                  |
| [R-HOST-2](../DESIGN.md#hidden-must-keep-working)                   | MUST   | Hiding optional content also removes accidental gaps.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | browser                                                             |
| [R-BUILD-1](../DESIGN.md#hold-what-you-build)                       | MUST   | Append shadow structure in the constructor; content that genuinely cannot exist yet is mounted later only with the documented `// deferred mount: <why>` marker on the line above, which also says how a second append is prevented.                                                                                                                    | check:shadow-mount-outside-constructor                              |
| [R-BUILD-2](../DESIGN.md#hold-what-you-build)                       | MUST   | Retain the references to what you built; do not rediscover them through selectors.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | check:built-then-queried                                            |
| [R-NAME-1](../DESIGN.md#ranui-component-token-naming)               | SHOULD | Use `--ran-{component}-{element}[-{state}]-{property}`, keeping the existing component prefix.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |                                                                     |
| [R-NAME-2](../DESIGN.md#ranui-component-token-naming)               | SHOULD | Name the most specific distinct UI part, not its full DOM/BEM path; drop wrapper/position segments that add no identity.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                                                                     |
| [R-NAME-3](../DESIGN.md#ranui-component-token-naming)               | SHOULD | Keep track/fill as separate parts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |                                                                     |
| [R-NAME-4](../DESIGN.md#ranui-component-token-naming)               | MUST   | The state segment is optional, and when present corresponds to an independently overridable interaction state.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | review                                                              |
| [R-NAME-5](../DESIGN.md#ranui-component-token-naming)               | SHOULD | Property names retain their CSS meaning.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                                                                     |
| [R-NAME-6](../DESIGN.md#ranui-component-token-naming)               | SHOULD | Aim for at most four semantic segments after `ran`, without collapsing distinct override points merely to shorten a name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |                                                                     |
| [R-NAME-7](../DESIGN.md#ranui-component-token-naming)               | SHOULD | Do not hand-maintain another token catalog.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |                                                                     |
| [R-COMPOSE-1](../DESIGN.md#applying-generic-composition-to-ranui)   | SHOULD | Map the [navigation-layer rules](../DESIGN.md#containers-do-not-fix-structure) to ranui as follows: `r-modal` for a short confirmation or a single field, `r-popover` / `r-dropdown` for transient context, `r-disclosure-row` for progressive disclosure, and `r-tabs` only for peer views of one object.                                              |                                                                     |
| [R-COMPOSE-2](../DESIGN.md#ranui-spacing-relationships)             | SHOULD | Space each relationship with the token the table above maps it to.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |                                                                     |
| [R-COMPOSE-3](../DESIGN.md#ranui-spacing-relationships)             | MAY    | Major regions use `--ran-space-10` when their relationship warrants it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                                                                     |
| [R-COMPOSE-4](../DESIGN.md#ranui-spacing-relationships)             | MUST   | Absent descriptions leave no vacant row.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | browser                                                             |
| [R-COMPOSE-5](../DESIGN.md#ranui-spacing-relationships)             | SHOULD | For geometry proofs, measure the host, documented shadow parts and slotted text.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |                                                                     |
| [R-COMPOSE-6](../DESIGN.md#ranui-spacing-relationships)             | SHOULD | Use `ranui/testing` for closed-root browser tests.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |                                                                     |
| [R-COMPOSE-7](../DESIGN.md#ranui-spacing-relationships)             | MUST   | Do not introduce production shadow queries.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | review                                                              |
| [R-COMPOSE-8](../DESIGN.md#ranui-spacing-relationships)             | SHOULD | Use generated public variables and parts for overrides.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                                                                     |
| [R-COMPOSE-9](../DESIGN.md#ranui-spacing-relationships)             | MAY    | Consumer aliases may improve naming while deriving their values from the existing `--ran-*` foundation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                                                                     |
| [R-COMPOSE-10](../DESIGN.md#ranui-spacing-relationships)            | MUST   | Verify coarse-input bounds independently.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | browser                                                             |
| [R-COMPOSE-11](../DESIGN.md#ranui-spacing-relationships)            | SHOULD | Where table, tree, calendar, kanban or timeline views are needed, use semantic host implementations with these same foundation roles.                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |                                                                     |
